original_ai_output.title_zh: 南苏丹人权倡导者呼吁民众促进和平、消除冲突诱因
original_ai_output.summary_zh: 南苏丹人权捍卫者网络秘书处负责人James Bidal呼吁南苏丹民众将和平信息带入社区，在12月大选前消除冲突的早期诱因。他在研讨会上指出，暴力并非始于投票箱，而是更早地源于煽动性言论、仇恨言论和虚假信息。与会者强调妇女在选举各阶段维护社会稳定中的关键作用，并指出选举筹备是涵盖选前、投票日和选后的持续过程。

key_facts.fact: 南苏丹人权捍卫者网络秘书处负责人James Bidal呼吁民众将和平信息带入社区，以在12月大选前消除冲突早期诱因
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: The head of the South Sudan Human Rights Defenders Network (SSHRD) Secretariat, James Bidal, has urged South Sudanese to take messages of peace directly into their communities to eliminate early triggers of conflict as the country prepares for the general election in December.

key_facts.fact: Bidal称暴力并非始于投票箱，而是更早地源于煽动性言论、仇恨言论和虚假信息
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: Violence does not begin at the ballot box; it begins much earlier through inflammatory rhetoric, hate speech, and disinformation

key_facts.fact: 南苏丹将于12月举行大选
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: as the country prepares for the general election in December

key_facts.fact: 国家建设和平部性别与和平监测协调人Jenifer Bangbe称选举筹备是涵盖选前、投票日和选后的持续过程
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: preparing for elections is a continuous process encompassing pre-election, polling day, and post-election phases

uncertainties: 该事件目前仅有一个来源（Radio Tamazuj）报道，尚缺乏交叉验证
